notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Gnome creature that does not have summoning sickness. Anim Pakal has at least four +1/+1 counters on it. An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare any non-Gnome creature you control as an attacker.
Anim Pakal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then creating at least five 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by saacrificing five Gnomes, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
